name: deepseek-harness-mcp
description: Run DeepSeek Harness locally in a visible Web session controlled and reviewed by Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run and watch a local DeepSeek coding agent.
interface.longDescription: Codex starts the local DeepSeek Harness Web UI, opens it for the user, delegates a scoped coding task into the visible session, and independently reviews the workspace changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the local DeepSeek Harness Web UI, delegate this coding task into a visible session, then review and verify the result yourself.
